variants.headline: Building job cancelled part-way
variants.body: The building job for {project}, undertaken by {builder}, has been cancelled part-way. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Client abandons the construction plan
variants.body: The client has abandoned {project}, which {builder} was building. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Unfinished work meets a cancelled project
variants.body: Construction of {project} by {builder} has been cancelled before completion. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
